name: Sequence T — the trial as the hook
source: The 30-Day Trial.docx, Section 10 ({{Slot}} renamed to {Slot}); shortened to the voice rules in docs/IMPROVE-PASS.md §B (touch 1 under 80 words, follow-ups under 50, one question, plain opt-out). The $7 line stays (SPEC decision 3).

touches.subject: 30-day trial for {Company}
touches.body:
Hi {FirstName},

I run Aviance. We book sales calls for {niche} through cold email.

For {Company}, we'd run it free for 30 days: two inboxes, a checked list of {ICP}, emails sent in your name, and calls booked onto your calendar. No qualified call by Day 30 means we keep going free until there's one.

The catch: an honest review when it's over.

Worth a 10-minute call to see if {Company} qualifies?

{FirstName}, one thing I left out: this costs us about seven dollars a month in inboxes, plus a few hours. We're new, and we don't have public reviews yet. An honest review at the end is what we're after.

We run three at a time. Want a slot?

touches.subject: {Count} companies in {City}
touches.body:
{FirstName}, I pulled the list: {Count} businesses near {City} with {size} staff that look like your customers.

The trial emails 400 of them, free, for 30 days. If a customer is worth ${dealValue} to you, one call pays for a year of anything we'd charge.

Want the slot?

{FirstName}, I'll take it that booked calls aren't the priority right now, and close the file on {Company}.

If that changes, reply any time and I'll reopen a trial slot.
